subject: Election of New Commission Officers
overview: The commission elected Joe Rodane as Chair and Hasitha as Vice Chair following the retirement of long-time chair Christopher Bader. Members also discussed the final filing requirements for the South Street Historic District and technical difficulties regarding website migration.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes from the previous meeting, which detailed a chimney cap application and the handling of an open meeting law complaint.

items.title: South Street Historic District Status
items.summary: Noted that the district map must be filed with the Registrar of Deeds to finalize the official status of the South Street Historic District.

items.title: Website Migration and Maintenance
items.summary: Discussed the city's lack of technical resources to migrate the commission's website from its current third-party host to city-managed servers.

items.title: Election of Officers
items.summary: Elected Joe Rodane as Chair and Hasitha as Vice Chair following the retirement of Christopher Bader; the position of Secretary remains vacant.
